title: shifted telemetry compressor and humanized handoff note generator
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: On-call handoffs often arrive with large telemetry attachments and ambiguous next steps. This PR introduces a compact telemetry compressor and a humanized handoff note generator to reduce payload size, remove PII, and provide a cognitive-load estimate and a canary-safe rollback playbook seeded from the collected snapshot. The snapshot collector produces a small 'repro trailer' containing minimal trace slices, top-k logs by error signature, sampled heap/disk metadata and a KV diff bundle. The compressor uses a delta-based rolling window (inspired by rsync-style chunking) plus optional gzip fallback to guarantee size and decompression determinism across platforms. The handoff note generator templates the critical actions, suggested playbook steps, and a short 'operator confidence' metric based on recent similar incidents and successful mitigations. Implementation: adds a new CLI verb incidentctl snapshot gather --compress --seed-playbook and a library package pkg/snapshot with Collector, Compressor and Trailer types. A separate pkg/handoff contains the seeder that turns a trailer into a markdown handoff and an optional canary rollback playbook with explicit verify steps and automated guard rails. Security and privacy: redaction is performed by pkg/sanitize with configurable KMS-backed rules and a strict opt-in flag for payload upload to shared storage. Backwards compatibility: the compressor emits a stable v1 blob header; receivers without decompressor will still get an uncompressed JSON summary. Tests: end-to-end tests simulate 3 incident shapes, compression roundtrip checks, and a small fuzz harness for redaction rules. CI: initial run surfaced a flaky TestHandoffTemplate which was fixed by adding deterministic timestamping in tests. Rationale and impact: expected to reduce average snapshot upload size by 6x for verbose cases, speed up multi-region handoffs, and reduce cognitive overhead for the next responder through structured notes. Commit summary: see commits field. Files changed: see files_changed list. Review: requested tighter PII redaction and explicit opt-in semantics, added audit logs for redaction decisions, added unit tests for compressor edge cases, approved after second iteration. Merge: squash merged to main after CI green and two approvals. Related work: referenced ENG-1423 for handoff UX and SRE-88 for snapshot retention policy. Manual rollout: feature gated behind INCIDENT_SNAPSHOT_V2 and off by default in hosted instance.

release_notes: Added incidentctl snapshot gather command with optional compression and playbook seeding.
Introduced compact 'repro trailer' format v1 to reduce telemetry payloads.
Handoff notes include a suggested canary rollback playbook and an operator confidence estimate.
Feature is behind INCIDENT_SNAPSHOT_V2 feature flag and off by default for hosted customers.
